title: Dragon Vein Awakening
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment the Dragon Vein power was completely integrated, Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura approaching from outside the ruins—the unique aura of the Demonic Path commander. What chilled him even more was that this person carried blood of the same origin as his own. The twin children of destiny were finally about to meet in the depths of these ruins.

text.content: At the end of the corridor deep in the ruins, a stone door sealed for ten thousand years slowly opened. Chen Ji stood before it, feeling the faint pulsation emanating from behind the door—the heartbeat of the Dragon Vein, resonating with the blood in his chest. With each breath, it seemed they were engaged in some kind of dialogue spanning across time and space. Mo Xiansheng handed him the Jade Pendant. The touch was warm and smooth as jade, yet faintly scalding, as if reminding him of something.

Passing through the stone door, the scene before Chen Ji's eyes made his pupils shrink. A massive dragon-shaped spiritual vein lay across the underground palace, its entire body composed of golden Spiritual Mine. The dragon's head was raised high, its tail winding for thousands of zhang, emitting an ancient and primordial pressure. Most shocking of all, at the core of that Dragon Vein, there was a fist-sized golden Dragon Orb, flickering with each pulsation.

dialogue.content: "So this is the Dragon Vein core..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice trembled slightly. "Long ago, your ancestor Chen Xuan took the Tianji Record Fragment from here. This Dragon Orb contains the power to change causality, but to make it recognize you as master, you must endure the agony of ten thousand scales piercing your heart."

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. He simply placed the Jade Pendant in his chest and walked slowly toward the Dragon Vein. With each step, he could feel the scrutiny from the Dragon Vein—that power was scanning his bloodline, his soul, everything about him. Finally, he stood before the Dragon Orb, extended his hand, and pressed his palm against the scorching golden sphere.

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand scales piercing the heart?" Chen Ji suddenly smiled, his expression carrying a hint of playfulness. "That's easier than I anticipated. After all, the pain I've endured over these years has long since accustomed me to the edge of limits."

choice.prompt: The Dragon Orb was within reach, but the fusion process was extremely dangerous. Chen Ji needed to make a choice—whether to use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to fuse quickly and seize the advantage, or to proceed steadily and endure the complete trial to obtain purer power?

choices.description: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate points to activate the deep foresight ability of the Tianji Record, seize the advantage in the Dragon Vein's trial, and significantly shorten the fusion time.
choices.visible_reward: Fusion time reduced by 70%, preserving more Heavenly Fate points to handle subsequent crises
choices.risk_hint: May not obtain the most complete inheritance of the Dragon Vein, and the energy fluctuations from rapid fusion are more easily detected by the outside world

text.content: A flash of determination appeared in Chen Ji's eyes. The Heavenly Fate points ignited instantly, transforming into golden light that wrapped around his palm. The Dragon Orb seemed to sense something and actively burst forth with dazzling radiance, beginning to rapidly flow into his meridians.

choices.description: Without relying on the Tianji Record's power, complete the Dragon Vein's recognition through pure willpower and bloodline affinity, enduring the complete pain of ten thousand scales piercing the heart.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the most complete inheritance of the Dragon Vein, with more pure and unblemished fused power
choices.risk_hint: Fusion time lasts three hours, and interruption during this period would have dire consequences

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and withdrew the Tianji Record power from his fingertips. He chose the most笨拙、most painful, but also most solid way to complete this fusion. The moment his palm touched the Dragon Orb, agony came like a tide.

The agony came more intense than anticipated. Countless golden scales shot out from the Dragon Orb, piercing through Chen Ji's skin, flesh, and bones like a violent storm, reaching directly into the depths of his soul. Each scale carried the will of the ancient dragon clan, tearing at his consciousness, attempting to completely destroy him.

Chen Ji gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, yet he did not let out a single groan. His consciousness was like a small boat, bobbing in the monstrous waves, yet never capsizing. The more intense the pain, the more resolute his conviction became—to find his sister Chen Nian, to oppose that Eye of Heavenly Providence, he had to survive.

dialogue.content: "Is this all..." Chen Ji挤出几个字 from between his teeth, yet a mocking smile actually tugged at the corner of his mouth. "When I had three ribs broken by others in the Servants' Quarters, that was far more painful than this."

text.content: However, just then, a sensation more terrifying than pain welled up in his heart—the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Providence. That transcendent consciousness was like an invisible eye, penetrating the layers of obstacles in the ruins, staring fixedly at the direction of the Dragon Vein awakening. Chen Ji's heart tightened, yet he forced himself to remain calm.

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Providence has already sensed the fluctuations of the Dragon Vein awakening! Chen Ji must make a choice—whether to divert some energy to interfere with the Tianji Record's predictions to buy more fusion time, or concentrate all his will to accelerate the fusion and gamble on speed?

choices.description: Divert partial consciousness to activate the Tianji Record Fragment, releasing a large amount of false information to interfere with the Eye of Heavenly Providence's judgment, buying time for fusion.
choices.visible_reward: Sufficient fusion time obtained, and the Eye of Heavenly Providence will temporarily lose precise positioning of this location
choices.risk_hint: Distraction may cause accidents during fusion, and more spiritual energy will be consumed

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his left hand secretly forming a seal. The Tianji Record Fragment rapidly flipped in his mind, releasing a stream of false aura fluctuations—directions of Xuanwu Sect, positions of the Demonic Holy Sect, countless mixed Dragon Vein auras.

choices.description: Regardless of external interference, invest all consciousness into fusion, forcibly accelerating the fusion process by burning potential.
choices.visible_cost: Potential damaged, future growth space may be limited
choices.visible_reward: Fusion speed doubled, completing recognition before the Eye of Heavenly Providence locks on
choices.risk_hint: Forced acceleration may cause incomplete fusion, and damage to the body is irreversible

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely closed his eyes, cutting off all stray thoughts. His consciousness transformed into a blade, ruthlessly stabbing into the core of the Dragon Orb, forcibly compressing the fusion process that originally required three hours. Blood seeped from the corners of his eyes, nostrils, and mouth—truly shocking to behold.

The bombardment of golden scales gradually weakened, replaced by a warm force flowing through his meridians. The Dragon Vein power was undergoing its final alignment with his flesh, marrow, and soul. Chen Ji felt every cell in his body rejoicing, as if finding a long-lost home.

Just as the fusion was about to complete, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. An unprecedented flood of information surged into Chen Ji's mind—the mysteries of causal power, the deepest inheritance of the Dragon Vein. Countless threads of destiny appeared before his eyes, and he, incredibly, could manipulate even the most subtle of them.

dialogue.content: "This is... a fragment of the Law of Causality!" Mo Xiansheng's voice was full of shock. "You actually succeeded! With this power, you can rewrite causality within a short range—although just for an instant, although the cost is tremendous, this is the key to opposing the Eye of Heavenly Providence!"

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, golden dragon patterns faintly flowing in his pupils. He gently waved his right hand, and a subtle crack appeared in the air—the mark of rewritten causality. In that instant, the "effect" actually appeared before the "cause." This was the newest ability granted by the Dragon Vein: Reverse Cause Guide Effect.

choice.prompt: The Dragon Vein fusion is complete, but the Eye of Heavenly Providence's gaze grows ever stronger. Chen Ji needs to decide his next move—whether to leave immediately while the fusion's resonance still lingers to avoid complications, or to actively release his aura to set a trap and await potential enemies?

choices.description: While the Dragon Vein power has not yet fully settled, immediately leave the ruins via the planned route, avoiding all possible conflict.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon other potential opportunities that might be obtained in the ruins
choices.visible_reward: Safely preserve the fruits of Dragon Vein recognition, avoiding direct confrontation with powerful enemies
choices.risk_hint: There may be other precious resources in the ruins that weren't explored in time, and the Eye of Heavenly Providence's aura tracking continues

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment. He turned and darted toward the exit. The Dragon Vein power surged within him, making his speed more than ten times faster than when he arrived. However, just as he was about to burst out of the ruins, a familiar aura suddenly rushed toward him.

choices.description: Actively release part of the Dragon Vein aura to attract enemies, use the newly acquired ability to set a trap, and await the unknown pursuer to counter-kill.
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's location, potentially attracting enemies far stronger than anticipated
choices.visible_reward: Opportunity to eliminate the eyes and ears of the Eye of Heavenly Providence, and can obtain intelligence on the enemy
choices.risk_hint: The enemy's strength may exceed expectations, and unknown dangers may be hidden deep within the ruins

text.content: A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. He deliberately left a trace of Dragon Vein aura at the ruins entrance, then concealed himself in the shadows, waiting quietly. The Tianji Record Fragment spun rapidly in his mind, capturing every subtle movement within a hundred zhang.

As the last trace of the Dragon Vein recognition's resonance faded, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented sense of fullness spreading through his body. The golden Dragon Orb had completely integrated into his dantian, every thread of Dragon Vein power merging with his true essence. More importantly, the Tianji Record Fragment had also evolved during this fusion—the originally blurry threads of causality now became clearly visible.

However, just as Chen Ji thought everything had settled, a cold, bone-penetrating aura suddenly spread from the depths of the ruins. That aura he knew too well—it was the unique aura of the Demonic Path commander, the supreme symbol of power in the Demonic Holy Sect. But what chilled him even more was that within that aura, he sensed a thread of power originating from the same bloodline as his own.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The truth of the twin children of destiny, that answer he had pursued for years, now abruptly appeared before him. He did not know whether the approaching presence was friend or foe, but he knew he had no more retreat. The Dragon Vein had recognized its master, and that power could no longer be hidden. The world beyond the ruins was about to be completely stirred up by this sudden reunion.
